en: Vintage, hand‑colored romantic postcard. Front shows a man tipping his hat and holding flowers at a rustic balcony covered with vines, greeting a woman; mountains in the background. A handwritten message runs along the bottom. The reverse has multilingual 'Postkarte — Carte postale' headings and a Swedish green 5 öre stamp with cancellation. Addressed in Swedish script to a woman in Malmö.
